meta.name: S Utkantha Priyadarshini Reddy
meta.tagline: Results-driven MCA graduate (8.28 CGPA) with practical experience in Data Analytics at CodeAlpha. Proficient in Python, SQL, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), statistical modeling, and data visualization to transform complex datasets into actionable business intelligence.

bullets: Conducted comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and statistical modeling using Python (Pandas, NumPy) to evaluate business metrics, revenue distributions, and promotional performance.
Engineered automated web scraping pipelines using BeautifulSoup to parse HTML DOM trees, handle pagination, and compile custom structured CSV datasets from dynamic web sources.
Built informative data visualizations and dashboards using Matplotlib and Seaborn, authoring data-driven executive reports that translate raw metrics into strategic business insights.
Queried relational databases via advanced SQL (multi-table joins, subqueries, aggregations) to ensure clean data pipelines for analysis and visualization workflows.
Awarded a verified Certificate of Completion and an official Letter of Recommendation for analytical excellence across all milestones.
Graduated with 8.28 CGPA; strengthened problem-solving, analytical thinking, and software development skills through academic coursework and hands-on projects.
Developed academic projects using Python, deep learning, full-stack web development, and Artificial Intelligence.
Gained strong knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, Database Management Systems (DBMS), Operating Systems, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
Graduated with 8.3 CGPA; developed strong competencies in analytical thinking, structured communication, and instructional design.
Gained expertise in innovative teaching methodologies, curriculum planning, and interpersonal engagement.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) – Physics & Physical Science
bullets: Graduated with 9.4 CGPA, securing First Position in the batch.
Built a strong foundation in analytical problem-solving, quantitative reasoning, and scientific research aptitude.

projects.title: E-Commerce Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
projects.description: Analyzed real-world e-commerce sales records, uncovering monthly revenue trends, product category distributions, and promotional discounts impact on net sales volume. Conducted statistical outlier detection and generated automated visual reports communicating actionable business growth recommendations.

projects.title: Superstore Sales Data Visualization & Reporting
projects.description: Performed deep-dive sales and profitability analysis across customer segments, geographic regions, and merchandise subcategories. Authored a structured business analytics report with custom visualizations highlighting loss-making categories and high-margin inventory drivers.

projects.title: Multi-Source Web Scraping Data Pipeline
projects.description: Developed modular web scrapers for extracting structured data from global sources including World Bank economic news, NASA archives, and e-commerce catalogs. Handled complex HTML navigation, user-agent headers, and automated data cleaning to export publication-ready tabular datasets.

projects.title: EduLearn – E-Learning Platform
projects.description: Designed and deployed a fully responsive e-learning web application using HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, hosted on Vercel with CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Implemented mobile-first responsive design ensuring seamless compatibility.

projects.title: Yamazone – E-Commerce Demo
projects.description: Built a full-stack e-commerce web application inspired by Amazon, with a Python Flask backend and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. Implemented product catalog API, Add-to-Cart drawer with live subtotal, and Buy Now order simulation.

projects.title: Aura Dex – Pokédex Web App
projects.description: AuraDex is a modern, beautifully designed full-stack Pokédex application featuring a premium glassmorphism UI, smooth animations, and real-time data powered by the PokéAPI.

projects.title: Nexus Cloud – Cloud Storage Drive
projects.description: A modern, full-stack cloud storage application featuring secure file management, granular sharing permissions, and a responsive interface built with the MERN stack.

projects.title: Pawfect Match – Pet Adoption Platform
